summary_rationale: Cyient Limited is a credible, cash-generative engineering R&D franchise undergoing a high-stakes structural transformation. Its core Digital, Engineering & Technology (DET) segment—anchored by multi-decade Tier-1 relationships with Pratt & Whitney, Airbus, and global rail/telecom OEMs—demonstrated operational resilience in Q2 FY27, expanding EBIT margins to a 10-quarter high of 14.2% under new CEO Sukamal Banerjee, while Cyient DLM (1.6x+ book-to-bill) and Cyient Semiconductors (+240.8% YoY) provide secular top-line engines. Historically, Cyient has maintained clean receivables (66 debtor days) and strong cash conversion (₹787 Cr CFO and ₹693 Cr FCF in FY26, 118% CFO/EBITDA). However, Cyient does not currently qualify as an unconditional compounder for three reasons: (1) 5-year sales CAGR slowed to 12.0% with ROCE compressing from 22% (FY24) to 12.3% (FY26) and trailing ROE at 8.61%; (2) DLM manufacturing has stretched the Cash Conversion Cycle to 119 days; and (3) a simultaneous ₹720 Cr buyback and two major acquisitions (Kinetic Technologies for ~$85M and TAO Digital for ~$218M) drove borrowings up 6.4x from ₹431 Cr (Mar 2026) to ₹2,759 Cr (Sep 2026) and nearly doubled Fixed Assets/intangibles to ₹6,021 Cr. Quality is conditional on smooth M&A integration, margin durability, and steady deleveraging.
